Container.Name: MediaLens
Container.Overview: Read-only media library analyzer for movies and TV shows, with detailed HDR, Dolby Vision, audio, codec, subtitle, and hardware compatibility analysis.
Container.Description:
MediaLens analyzes local movie and TV libraries without modifying the source media. It identifies video codecs, resolutions, HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision profiles including Profile 7 FEL/MEL, Dolby Atmos, DTS:X, lossless audio, subtitles, bitrate information, and playback compatibility across popular media devices.
MediaLens stores its database under /data and mounts media libraries read-only. It supports automatic scanning with file-copy stability checks and periodic reconciliation.
The included first-run setup wizard can create Movies and TV Shows libraries using the /media/movies and /media/tv container paths.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent MediaLens application data and SQLite database. Keep this path when upgrading or recreating the container.

Config.Name: Movies
Config.Description: Read-only path to your Movies library. The container path /media/movies is used by the MediaLens setup wizard.

Config.Name: TV Shows
Config.Description: Read-only path to your TV Shows library. The container path /media/tv is used by the MediaLens setup wizard.

Config.Name: Automatic Scanning
Config.Description: Automatically detect newly added or changed media files.

Config.Name: File Stability Seconds
Config.Description: Number of seconds a new or changed file must remain stable before MediaLens analyzes it.

Config.Name: Reconcile Interval Minutes
Config.Description: How often MediaLens reconciles the library for missed changes.
